answer: Per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting or grading, every identity locks 100 USDC in escrow. A farm of 1000 clones locks 100,000 USDC and forfeits it all when audit detects duplicate device IDs. The escrow inlet writes deposits to a ledger on a Zephyr RTOS node; a marble-enclosed HSM signs slash orders. Honesty stays cheaper.
